exposure: high-risk pregnancy status (identified by Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan criteria)
outcome: maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at PCMS & RC Bhopal between January 1, 2024, and December 31, 2024.
finding: Nearly half of the pregnant women were classified as high-risk, with hypertensive disorders being a common contributor, and high-risk status was significantly associated with adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes such as preterm births and low birth weight.
cross-section timing: Data collected from deliveries between January 1, 2024, and December 31, 2024.
birth_weight: Low birth weight infants (proportion compared between groups, specific weight not mentioned).
gest_age: Preterm births (proportion compared between groups, specific gestational age not mentioned).
